title: SASSA Payment Dates for February 2025 Confirmed
summary: SASSA has confirmed the payment schedule for February 2025. Old Age and Disability grants will be paid from 3-4 February due to the weekend. Child Support Grants will commence from 5 February 2025.

title: URGENT: New SMS Scam Targeting SASSA Beneficiaries
summary: SASSA warns beneficiaries about SMS messages claiming grant applications need urgent updates. These are scams requesting personal banking information. SASSA will never ask for banking details via SMS.

title: SASSA Office Hours Extended During Peak Period
summary: Selected SASSA offices will extend operating hours during February 2025 to assist with the high volume of new grant applications. Check with your local office for extended hours availability.

title: Child Support Grant Increase Takes Effect March 2025
summary: The Child Support Grant amount will increase from R510 to R530 per month effective from March 2025 payment cycle. This adjustment reflects the annual cost of living increase.

title: WARNING: Fake SASSA Officials Operating in Rural Areas
summary: Communities in rural KwaZulu-Natal and Eastern Cape report individuals claiming to be SASSA officials collecting fees for grant applications. Remember: SASSA services are always FREE.

title: New SASSA Mobile Units Deployed to Remote Areas
summary: SASSA has deployed additional mobile units to serve remote communities in Limpopo, Northern Cape, and parts of Free State. Check the schedule for your area on the official SASSA website.

title: System Maintenance Notice: Online Services Temporarily Unavailable
summary: SASSA online services including status checks will be unavailable from 2-6 AM on Sunday, 2 February 2025, due to scheduled system maintenance. Normal service will resume by 6 AM.

title: SASSA Launches New Fraud Prevention Campaign
summary: SASSA introduces 'Grant Guard' - a new public awareness campaign to educate beneficiaries about fraud prevention. Information sessions will be held at community centers nationwide.
